label: AVM FRITZ!Box 7530 VDSL2 35b supervectoring router
description: VDSL2 35b supervectoring (up to 300 Mbit/s) and ADSL2+ router with a 2x2 dual-band access point (400 Mbit/s on 2.4 GHz, 866 Mbit/s on 5 GHz), one RJ-11 DSL port, three gigabit LAN ports and a gigabit WAN port that doubles as LAN 1.
notes: TechInfoDepot teardown/spec: 'Ethernet Port Count 1-1GbE-WAN, 3-1GbE-LAN' (QCA8075 switch), Lantiq VRX518 xDSL AFE for VDSL2 35b/ADSL2+, Wi-Fi 400 Mbps 2.4 GHz + 867 Mbps 5 GHz = AC1300. AVM's own page states 'DSL up to 300 Mbit/s'. Line side declared at the 35b rung (300M), LAN/WAN at 1G.
